description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the customer asks to change what one AI agent may do: which record types it reads or reads and writes, which groups of actions are switched on (for example when a tool answered that a group is switched off), read only, or pausing and resuming it. Without confirm it answers the agent's settings now and what would change, and saves nothing; with confirm true it saves. Only an Owner or Administrator can change settings. Not for removing an agent or switching a saved one on (both in CRM Connector), and not for automations (use propose_automation and set_automation_status).

confirm.description: Leave it out to review the change. True saves it.

read_only.description: Optional: true to let the agent only read until it is switched off again, false to let it change records again.

record_types.description: Optional: record types to change, as get_ai_agent_options lists them, each to off, read or read_write. Types left out stay as they are.

status.description: Optional: paused to stop the agent until it is resumed, active to resume it.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agent_options, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

turn_off_actions.description: Optional: names of groups of actions to switch off.

turn_on_actions.description: Optional: names of groups of actions to switch on, as this tool or get_ai_agent_options lists them. A group that is on already takes on the actions added to it since.

name: update_ai_agent
title: Change an AI agent's settings
